title: Deploying and Publishing Apps
description: Learn how to prepare your React Native app for production, and publish it on app stores like Google Play and Apple App Store.

lessons.title: Why Deploy and Publish?
lessons.content: Deploying your app makes it accessible to users worldwide. Publishing on app stores helps you reach millions, get feedback, and grow your user base.

lessons.title: Preparing Your App for Production
lessons.content: Before publishing, optimize your app by removing debug code, enabling ProGuard (Android), setting up app icons, splash screens, and configuring permissions.

lessons.title: Generating a Signed APK for Android
lessons.content:
1. Generate a signing key using keytool:

```
keytool -genkey -v -keystore my-release-key.keystore -alias my-key-alias -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
```

2. Place the keystore in `android/app` folder.

3. Edit `android/gradle.properties`:

```
MYAPP_UPLOAD_STORE_FILE=my-release-key.keystore
MYAPP_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS=my-key-alias
MYAPP_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD=your-store-password
MYAPP_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD=your-key-password
```

4. Edit `android/app/build.gradle` to add signing configs.

5. Build the release APK:

```
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
```

6. The APK will be at `android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`.

lessons.title: Publishing on Google Play Store
lessons.content: Create a Google Play Developer account, pay the one-time fee, create a new app, upload your signed APK or AAB, add app details, screenshots, privacy policy, and submit for review.

lessons.title: Building and Archiving for iOS
lessons.content:
1. Open your React Native iOS project in Xcode.
2. Configure your app’s bundle identifier, signing team, and provisioning profiles.
3. Select 'Generic iOS Device' and create an archive via Product > Archive.
4. Export the archive as an IPA for App Store submission.

lessons.title: Publishing on Apple App Store
lessons.content: Enroll in the Apple Developer Program, use App Store Connect to create your app listing, upload your IPA using Transporter or Xcode, fill in app info, and submit for review.

lessons.title: App Store Guidelines and Compliance
lessons.content: Follow platform guidelines on content, privacy, and functionality to avoid rejection. Include clear privacy policies and test on real devices.

lessons.title: Over-the-Air Updates with CodePush
lessons.content: CodePush lets you push JS updates instantly without going through app store reviews, speeding up bug fixes and feature delivery.

lessons.title: Monitoring App Performance and Crashes
lessons.content: Use tools like Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to track app crashes and performance issues post-deployment.

lessons.title: Maintaining and Updating Your App
lessons.content: Regularly update your app to fix bugs, add features, and keep dependencies up to date to provide users the best experience.
